topic: Replacing a Lost Debit Card at the Bank

script.title: THE LOST DEBIT CARD
script.scene_zh: 銀行櫃台 · 掛失補卡
script.story_hook: Her card vanished overnight, but her morning didn't.
script.intro_zh: 她的提款卡一夜之間不見了，但她的一天沒有泡湯。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's bank scene. Listen for handy card phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的銀行場景。留意實用的補卡說法。
script.outro: And that's a lost card fixed in minutes. Listen again and try the key lines.
script.outro_zh: 遺失的提款卡就這樣在幾分鐘內搞定。再聽一次，跟著說說關鍵句。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her mid thirties with auburn hair in a chin-length bob, silver hoop earrings, a tan trench coat over a white blouse, a leather shoulder bag, and an average build
script.char_b_description: a balding man in his fifties with thin grey hair at the sides, rectangular glasses, a navy bank vest over a light blue shirt, a name tag on his chest, and a tall thin build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I lost my debit card last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ lɑst maɪ ˈdɛbɪt kɑɹd lɑst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我昨晚把提款卡弄丟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, that's never a fun morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæts ˈnɛvɚ ə fʌn ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，遇到這種事的早晨一定很糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning, yes. My wallet's still right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔɹnɪŋ jɛs maɪ ˈwɑlɪt ɪz stɪl ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 就是今天早上的事。我的錢包其實還在身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So just the card is gone, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ dʒʌst ðə kɑɹd ɪz ɡɑn ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 所以只有卡片不見了，是這樣吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. I froze it on the app first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli aɪ froʊz ɪt ɑn ðə æp fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。我第一個動作就是在手機軟體上鎖卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move. Let me pull up your account.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt muv lɛt mi pʊl ʌp jɔɹ əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 很聰明。我幫您調出帳戶資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, it's Dana Whitfield, D-A-N-A.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɚ aɪts ˈdænə ˈwɪtfɪld ˈdi ˈeɪ ɛn ˈeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好的，戶名是 Dana Whitfield，Dana 拼作 D-A-N-A。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, Dana. I see the freeze from eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ˈdænə aɪ si ðə froʊz fɹʌm eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，Dana。我看到您八點的鎖卡紀錄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, um, the app locked it right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /je ʌm ði æp lɑkt ɪt ɹaɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，嗯，軟體當下立刻就把卡鎖住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Nobody's used it since the lock, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈnoʊbɑdiz juːzd ɪt sɪns ðə lɑk baɪ ðə ˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很好。順帶一提，鎖卡之後沒有任何刷過的紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a relief, honestly. I panicked a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /wət ə ɹɪˈlif ˈɑnəstli aɪ ˈpænɪkt ə ˈlɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 老實說真的鬆了口氣，我剛剛嚇了一跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally normal. Now, do you want a new card today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli ˈnɔɹməl nau du ju wɑnt ə nu kɑɹd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很正常的。那您想今天就拿新卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please. How soon can I get one?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz haʊ suːn kən aɪ ɡɛt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好啊。最快多久能拿到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can print it here, instantly, no waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən prɪnt ɪt hɪɹ ˈɪnstəntli noʊ ˈweɾɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我們在這裡當場就能印，馬上，不用等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the number changes too, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðə ˈnʌmbɚ ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz tu raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，卡號也會換新的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does. New card means new number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈdʌz nu kɑɹd minz nu ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。新卡就是新卡號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's where I get nervous.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðæts wɛɹ aɪ ɡɛt ˈnɝvəs/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這就是讓我緊張的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why's that? Anything specific worrying you?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪz ðæts ˈɛniθɪŋ spəˈsɪfɪk ˈwɝyin ju/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼說？有什麼具體擔心的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, my gym charges my card every month.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl maɪ ˈdʒɪm ˈtʃɑɹdʒəz maɪ kɑɹd ˈɛvɹi mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我的健身房每個月都從這張卡扣錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Autopay, got it. Any others on that card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔɾopeɪ ɡɑɾ ɪt ˈɛni ˈʌðɚz ɑn ðæt kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 自動扣款，了解了。這張卡還綁了別的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phone bill, water, and my streaming stuff.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊn bɪl ˈwɔɾɚ ænd maɪ ˈstɹiminɪŋ ˈstʌf/
dialogue.zh: 手機帳單、水費，還有一些串流訂閱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, here's the thing — each needs the new number.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ hɪɹz ðə θɪŋ itʃ ˈniz ðə nu ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，重點是——每一筆都要換成新卡號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All of them? Ugh, that sounds painful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑl ʌv ðɛm ʌɡ ðæt saʊndz ˈpeɪnfəl/
dialogue.zh: 全部都要？噢，聽起來好麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's ten minutes of updates, tops, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts tɛn ˈmɪnəts əv əpˈdeɪts tɑps aɪ pɹəˈmaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 更新最多十分鐘就搞定了，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine. Can you print me a list of them?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn kən ju prɪnt mi ə lɪst ʌv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 好吧。可以幫我印一份清單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Actually, our system shows recent autopays right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli aʊɹ ˈsɪstəm ʃoz ˈɹisənt ˈɔɾopeɪz ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 其實在我們這套系統上，就看得到最近的自動扣款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, so you can see who charges me?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs soʊ ju kən si hu ˈtʃɑɹdʒəz mi/
dialogue.zh: 噢，太好了，所以你們看得到是誰在扣我的錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the recurring ones, and this screen's private.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə ɹɪˈkɝɪŋ wʌnz ænd ðis skɹinz ˈpɹaɪvət/
dialogue.zh: 只顯示定期扣款，而且這個螢幕是保密的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool, then please print that checklist for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul ðɛn pliz prɪnt ðæt ˈtʃɛklɪst fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 好，那就請幫我把那份清單印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One sec... here's gym, phone, streaming, two utilities.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɛk hɪɹz dʒɪm foʊn ˈstrimin tu juˈtɪlətiz/
dialogue.zh: 稍等我一下……出來了：健身房、手機、串流，還有兩筆水電費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, two utilities? I only know about water.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt tu juˈtɪlətiz aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈnoʊ əˈbaʊt ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，兩筆水電費？我只知道水費這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That second utility says Green Power, about forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsɛkənd juˈtɪləti sɛz ɡɹin ˈpaʊɚ əˈbaʊt ˈfɔɹti/
dialogue.zh: 第二筆水電費寫著 Green Power，金額大約四十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! That's my mom's electric company. I forgot.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts maɪ mɑmz ɪˈlɛktrɪk ˈkʌmpəni aɪ fɚˈɡɑt/
dialogue.zh: 噢！那是我媽媽的電力公司，我完全忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy fix: call them, or update it online.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizɪ fɪks kɔl ðɛm ɔɹ əpˈdeɪt ɪt ˈɑnlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 很好處理：打給他們，或者在線上改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll do it tonight while the coffee's warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl du ɪt təˈnaɪt waɪl ðə ˈkɔfi wɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 今晚趁咖啡還熱，我就趕快來改。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, there's the plan. Let's print that card.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɛɹz ðə plæn lɛts prɪnt ðæt kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，就這麼說定。我們來印新卡吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds great. Is there a fee for the fast card?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡɹeɪt ɪz ðɛɹ ə fim fɚ ðə fæst kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。請問快速補卡有手續費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually five dollars, but not when you freeze first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli faɪv ˈdɑlərz bʌt nɑt wɛn ju froʊz fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 通常是五美元，不過您先鎖了卡就免手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even better. What about my old PIN?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈbɛɾɚ wət əˈbaʊt maɪ oʊld pɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那更好了。我原本的提款密碼怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll pick a new one at any ATM.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul pɪk ə nu wʌn æt ˈɛni ˌeɪˌtiːˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 在任何一台提款機上重新設一組就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. How long until the new card works?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ haʊ lɔŋ ʌnˈtɪl ðə nu kɑɹd wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 好。那新卡多久可以使用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The moment we print it. Try it today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmoʊmənt wi prɪnt ɪt tɹai ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 印出來的那一刻就能用。今天就試試看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Um, my card had my transit pass too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ʌm maɪ kɑɹd hæd maɪ ˈtɹænzɪt pæs tu/
dialogue.zh: 完美。呃，我的舊卡上面還有交通票證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That part transfers automatically, nothing to do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pɑɹt tɹænsˈfɝɹz ˌɔːtəˈmætɪkli ˈnʌθɪŋ tu du/
dialogue.zh: 那個會自動轉移過來，您什麼都不用做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You just solved three problems in five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dʒʌst sɑlvd θɹi ˈpɹɑbləmz ɪn faɪv mɪˈnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 你五分鐘就幫我解決了三個問題耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll brag about that one at lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl bɹæɡ əˈbaʊt ðət wʌn æt lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這句我午餐時一定要跟同事炫耀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. So, where's this magic printer?
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du soʊ wɛɹz ðə ˈmædʒɪk ˈpɹɪntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，別客氣。所以，那台神奇印表機在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right behind me, it hums louder than it looks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt bɪˈhaɪnd mi ɪt hʌmz ˈluːdɚ ðæn ɪt lʊks/
dialogue.zh: 就在我身後，它的運轉聲比外觀誇張多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it, um, working? It sounded weird.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ʌm ˈwɝkɪŋ ɪt ˈsaʊndɪt wɪɹd/
dialogue.zh: 它，嗯，有在運轉嗎？剛剛的聲音怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a second... there she comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt ə ˈsɛkənd ðɛɹ ʃi kʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 再等一下……看，卡片出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's my new card? Already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ nu kɑɹd ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 那就是我的新卡？已經印好了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh plastic, still warm from the machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹæʃ ˈplæstɪk stɪl wɔɹm fɹʌm ðə məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 嶄新的卡片，還帶著機器的餘溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It even has my name spelled right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈivən hæz maɪ ˈneɪm spɛld ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 上面連我的名字都拼對了耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We take pride in small victories here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi teɪk pɹaɪd ɪn smɑl ˈvɪkəɹiz hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 這種小勝利，我們還挺引以為榮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My app still shows the frozen card, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ æp stɪl ʃoz ðə ˈfɹoʊzən kɑɹd ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可是我的手機軟體還顯示那張鎖住的舊卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one clears in an hour on its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn klɪɹz ɪn ɑn ˈaʊɚ ɑn ɪts oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 那個一小時後就會自動消失，不用管它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Activate where — on the app or by phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktɪveɪt wɛɹ ɑn ði æp ɔɹ baɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 請問要在哪裡啟用——手機軟體還是打電話？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: App's fastest, there's a big shiny button.
dialogue.phonetic: /æps ˈfæstəst ðɛɹz ə bɪɡ ˈʃaɪni ˈbʌtən/
dialogue.zh: 軟體最快，上面有一個又大又亮的按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done already. Wow, it really was instant.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ɔlˈrɛdi waʊ ɪt ˈɹiɹli wəz ˈɪnstənt/
dialogue.zh: 一下子就弄好了。哇，真的馬上就能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? New card, new number, zero drama.
dialogue.phonetic: /si nu kɑɹd nu ˈnʌmbɚ ˈzɪɹoʊ ˈdɹɑmə/
dialogue.zh: 看到了吧？新卡、新卡號、零麻煩。

script.youtube_title_en: "Three Problems in Five Minutes" — Replacing a Lost Debit Card at the Bank
script.youtube_description:
提款卡突然不見了，該怎麼辦？這一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力，帶你走過美國銀行櫃台補卡的全過程：先在手機軟體鎖卡，再請行員即場印一張新卡。

你會聽到：向行員說明卡片遺失、確認沒有人盜刷的句型；拿到新卡號時怎麼問手續費與密碼；健身房、水電帳單等自動扣款如何一筆一筆更新；還有即場印卡機發出怪聲時怎麼跟行員確認。

整段對話都是 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，充滿美國人日常的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、oh no。聽完你就會用：I lost my debit card last night、Let me pull up your account、How long until the new card works、zero drama。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，讓補卡這些句子變成你的直覺。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成母語。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱並打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
Your debit card is gone — now what? This 60-line immersive listening practice walks you through a real American bank counter: freezing the card in the app first, then printing a new one on the spot.

You will hear: how to report a lost card and confirm nobody used it, how to ask about fees and your new PIN, how every autopay (gym, phone, utilities) needs the new number, and what to do when the instant-issue printer acts up.

Everything stays in A2-level words with ten words or fewer per line, full of real American texture: um, well, so, ha, oh no. By the end you'll own lines like Let me pull up your account, How long until the new card works, and zero drama.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let these errands become instinct.

No memorizing needed — listen often and it sticks.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
早上打開錢包，提款卡竟然不見了？該先做什麼，才能保住帳戶裡的錢？卡號換新之後，那些每月自動扣款的健身房和水費怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進美國銀行的櫃台，從口頭掛失、手機鎖卡確認、即場印新卡，一路聽到自動扣款更新與啟用新卡，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📱 報失句：Hi, I lost my debit card last night.
🧾 確認安全：Nobody's used it since the lock, by the way.
💳 問卡號：Wait, the number changes too, right?
🏧 問手續費：Sounds great. Is there a fee for the fast card?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、oh no 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟補卡之行走一趟，下次你真的走進銀行，話自己就會從嘴邊冒出來。

願你的卡片永遠用不到這一集。
